title: Story premise ENT057: The Two-Weight Elevator
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: The lift keeps choosing a side. Takeaway/theme: A balance condition and a motion-control mechanism are separate questions.
description: A puppet needs to lower a toy platform gently, but the two removable counterweight blocks together outweigh it and one alone underbalances it in the simplified model. The puppet transfers a small labeled trim block to the platform, brings the stated totals into balance, and uses a visible hand crank for controlled movement.
